subject: Audit note: chart-theme.js hardcoded font sizes -- acceptable, document token gap
body:
## Finding
da-13: Chart label audit complete. shared/chart-theme.js uses hardcoded 13px font size for chart labels (Chart.defaults.font.size = 13). No MCM typography tokens used.

## Assessment: ACCEPTABLE (not a bug)
Chart.js cannot read CSS custom properties at runtime. JavaScript config must use resolved pixel values. Hardcoded 13px is:
- Within MCM type scale (--text-sm = 14px, --text-xs = 12px)
- Consistent across all charts
- Documented in chart-theme.js with comments

## Recommendation
Add a comment to chart-theme.js explaining why tokens aren't used:

```js
// Note: Chart.js cannot read CSS custom properties.
// 13px corresponds to approximately --text-sm (14px).
// If --text-sm changes, update this value manually.
Chart.defaults.font.size = 13;
```

This is a low-priority documentation change, not a bug fix.

## Also found
- score-big in index.html uses inline style for score COLOR (not size). The color is set via JS (scoreColor variable). The font-size token (--text-2xl) is correctly used in the CSS class. The inline color override is acceptable since score color is dynamic (green/red/amber based on score). But if MCM ever defines --color-score-pass and --color-score-fail tokens, those should replace the inline style.

## Action
Low-priority comment addition to chart-theme.js (can batch with next GA commit, no rush).
